what.text: Modafinil is a wakefulness-promoting drug taken by mouth. It is the active ingredient in Provigil. The FDA label says it is approved to improve wakefulness in adults with excessive sleepiness from narcolepsy, obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) or shift work disorder.
How it acts, according to the FDA label

items.text: The label says the way modafinil promotes wakefulness is unknown. Its wake-promoting effects resemble those of stimulants such as amphetamine and methylphenidate, but its profile is not identical.
In lab binding studies, modafinil binds to the dopamine reuptake site and raises dopamine outside nerve cells, without increasing dopamine release.
Modafinil is a 50:50 mix of two mirror-image forms, R and S. The R form is sold on its own as armodafinil (Nuvigil). After repeated doses, modafinil's elimination half-life is about 15 hours.

research.text: Modafinil's approved uses rest on placebo-controlled trials in people with sleep disorders. Its use for focus or fatigue in other people is off-label. Studies of those uses are smaller or mixed. Each is listed below as it was run.

items.text: two 9-week, placebo-controlled, double-blind US studies randomized 558 people with narcolepsy to modafinil 200 or 400 mg a day or placebo. Both measures, time to fall asleep on a wakefulness test and a clinician's global rating, improved compared with placebo.
a 12-week trial randomized 327 people already using CPAP; a 4-week trial randomized 157. In the 4-week trial, the Epworth Sleepiness Scale fell by 4.6 points on modafinil and 2.0 on placebo.
a 12-week placebo-controlled trial randomized 209 people with chronic shift work disorder to modafinil 200 mg or placebo.

research.title: Healthy young men, single dose (Psychopharmacology 2003)

facts.v: Turner DC, Robbins TW, Clark L, et al. Psychopharmacology (Berl) 2003;165(3):260-9
randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, between-subjects
60 healthy young adult men
a single dose of modafinil 100 mg or 200 mg, or placebo
one test session
a battery of memory, attention and planning tests

research.found: Modafinil improved scores on digit span, visual pattern recognition memory, spatial planning and stop-signal reaction time. It slowed responses on 3 tasks. It had no effect on spatial working memory, sustained attention, set-shifting or paired-associates learning. Effects were mostly not dose-dependent.

research.title: Healthy, rested adults (Eur Neuropsychopharmacol 2015)

facts.v: Battleday RM, Brem AK. Eur Neuropsychopharmacol 2015;25(11):1865-81
systematic review of primary studies in MEDLINE, 1990 to 2014
healthy people who were not sleep-deprived
attention, executive function, learning and memory, creativity, side effects and mood

research.found: Most studies using basic tests found better executive function; only about half found better attention or memory, and a few found worse creative thinking. Studies using more complex tests more often found gains. The authors found no excess of side effects or mood changes and called for better study methods.

src.label: Battleday and Brem, Eur Neuropsychopharmacol, PubMed

research.title: Cancer-related fatigue during chemotherapy (Cancer 2010)

facts.v: Jean-Pierre P, Morrow GR, Roscoe JA, et al. Cancer 2010;116(14):3513-20
multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3
867 people with fatigue starting chemotherapy were randomized; 631 gave usable data
modafinil 200 mg a day or placebo
from day 5 of chemotherapy cycle 2 to day 7 of cycle 4
worst fatigue in the past week; depression

research.found: The abstract reports that the effect depended on baseline fatigue (interaction P=.017): people with severe fatigue at the start (458) did better on modafinil, while people with mild or moderate fatigue did not. Depression did not change.

research.title: Fatigue in multiple sclerosis, 3 drugs vs placebo (Lancet Neurol 2021)

facts.v: Nourbakhsh B, Revirajan N, Morris B, et al. Lancet Neurol 2021;20(1):38-48
randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, 4-period crossover (NCT03185065)
141 people with MS and fatigue at 2 US centers; 136 analyzed
modafinil up to 100 mg twice a day, amantadine, methylphenidate and placebo, each in turn
up to 6 weeks per drug, with 2-week washouts
Modified Fatigue Impact Scale (MFIS)

research.found: Fatigue scores did not differ between the drugs and placebo (MFIS 39.0 on modafinil vs 40.6 on placebo; P=0.20 overall). Side effects were reported by 40% on modafinil vs 31% on placebo.

src.label: Nourbakhsh et al., Lancet Neurology, PubMed

us.text: Modafinil is FDA approved, by prescription, as Provigil. It is a Schedule IV controlled substance. Using it for focus, studying or general fatigue is off-label. As of November 1, 2026.

items.text: FDA's Drugs@FDA data show NDA 020717 approved December 24, 1998, with an efficacy supplement approved January 23, 2004. The current label lists narcolepsy, OSA and shift work disorder, in adults.

the label says Provigil contains modafinil, a Schedule IV controlled substance, and that modafinil produces psychoactive and euphoric effects typical of other stimulants. DEA's list of controlled substances shows modafinil in Schedule IV.

items.text: the label says Provigil is not approved for use in children for any indication.
using modafinil to improve focus or alertness in people without one of the approved conditions, or for fatigue in MS or cancer, is off-label. No FDA label lists these uses.

world.lead: Modafinil is an approved prescription medicine in the US, Canada, the UK, the EU and Australia. Since 2010 the EU and UK limit it to narcolepsy. It is banned in competition in sport.

countries.status: Approved medicine (Provigil 1998; narcolepsy, OSA, shift work disorder). Prescription-only, Schedule IV.

countries.status: Nationally authorised medicine. After a 2010 EU review, use is restricted to narcolepsy; OSA, shift work disorder and idiopathic hypersomnia were removed.
Approved medicine: TGA publishes product information for Modavigil and generic modafinil. Prescription-only (Schedule 4).

after.text: In 2016 the MHRA warned students against buying modafinil as a study aid. It said modafinil is licensed for specific medical conditions, not for use during exams, and that supplying prescription-only medicines without a prescription is a criminal offence.

after.title: Sport
after.text: Modafinil is named on the WADA 2026 Prohibited List in class S6.A, non-specified stimulants. It is prohibited in competition. The 2027 List, in force January 1, 2027, keeps modafinil in S6.A.

side.text: The label lists headache, nausea, nervousness, stuffy nose, diarrhea, back pain, anxiety, insomnia, dizziness and indigestion as the most common side effects. Serious risks include life-threatening rashes, multi-organ allergic reactions, psychiatric symptoms and heart effects.

items.text: in pooled placebo-controlled trials (934 on modafinil, 567 on placebo): headache 34% vs 23%, nausea 11% vs 3%, nervousness 7% vs 3%, anxiety 5% vs 1%, insomnia 5% vs 1%, loss of appetite 4% vs 1%, chest pain 3% vs 1%, high blood pressure 3% vs 1%.

serious rash needing hospital care has been reported, including Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis and DRESS. In children's trials, 0.8% (13 of 1,585) stopped because of rash. Most serious rashes began 1 to 5 weeks after starting. The label says to stop at the first sign of rash unless it is clearly not drug-related.
multi-organ allergic reactions, including at least one death, and angioedema have been reported.

mania, delusions, hallucinations, suicidal thoughts and aggression have been reported after approval, some needing hospital care. One healthy man given 600 mg a day with sleep deprivation developed paranoid delusions and hallucinations.

chest pain, palpitations and ECG changes occurred in trial subjects with mitral valve prolapse or left ventricular hypertrophy. The label advises against use in people with these conditions in certain cases. More people on modafinil needed new or increased blood-pressure medicine.
modafinil can make hormonal contraceptives less reliable, during use and for 1 month after stopping. It can also lower cyclosporine levels.
the label says modafinil can be abused and is reinforcing in monkeys trained to take cocaine.

in 2020 MHRA said modafinil may raise the risk of birth defects. A US registry estimated major malformations in about 14.75% of 78 prospective pregnancy cases, compared with 3% in the general population. MHRA says it should not be used in pregnancy.

items.text: an EU review found a strong link to serious skin reactions, higher in children, and links to psychiatric and heart side effects. It found the benefit outweighed the risk only in narcolepsy.

The 2027 WADA tracked-changes text was read as extracted text; the S6 heading 'prohibited in-competition' did not appear in the extraction, though the contents page still lists S6 under in-competition.
surprises: Modafinil is approved in the US for shift work disorder and OSA, but the EU and UK removed those uses in 2010-2011 after finding the benefit did not outweigh the risk there.
MHRA says modafinil is offered to students as a 'smart drug', yet in the US it is a Schedule IV controlled substance whose label warns of life-threatening rashes and psychiatric reactions.
In a 4-way crossover trial, modafinil did no better than placebo for fatigue in multiple sclerosis, a common off-label use.
